parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether renewal data is included. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the router interface.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
Resource Group ID.

For more information about resource groups, please refer to [What is a Resource Group?](~~94475~~)
